literature.topic_policy: Auditable title/journal keyword tags are navigation aids only and are not evidence-strength or effect classifications.

evidence_cards.extraction_policy: Metadata classification is automated and provisional. Integrity status remains unknown unless a collected source supplies an explicit post-publication update. Effect estimates, comparators, confounding, funding and risk-of-bias fields require source-grounded extraction and review before synthesis.

ohid_youth.interpretation: Official youth-vaping estimates from NHS England SDD and OHID are kept with survey/geography/demographic provenance. Percentages, unweighted bases and weighted bases must not be mixed across survey definitions or interpreted as causal health effects. NHS table schema changes fail closed for review.

regulatory_context.notice: This is a research timeline, not legal advice. Effective requirements must be checked against current legislation and official guidance.

environment_context.interpretation: General air-quality and satellite collectors are no longer part of the default vaping harvest. They may be enabled for a defined exposure study as background control data.

limitations: Counts are not effect estimates and do not establish causation, safety, harm or certainty.
Automated study-design classification is provisional until human review.
Structured comparator, outcome, effect-estimate, risk-of-bias and funding fields are not yet complete enough for pooled quantitative synthesis.
Recent-first literature surveillance is not yet a complete historical systematic review; backfill and incremental-update work remain separate stages.
Official prevalence estimates must retain survey, geography, confidence-interval and comparability metadata.
